main_text.l: וַתֵּלָא & defatigaris, vel tur, Job. 4. 5. (pro תִּלְאֶה,) fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. apoc. R. לאה.
תְּלָאוֹת siccitates, No. plur. fæm. Rad. inusit. לאב [?].
תְּלָאָה labor, defatigatio, (unde comp. cum מֵ, מֵתְּלָאָה quantum fatigationis, Mal. 1.13. pro מִתְּלָאָה,) No. f. f. Rad. לָאָה ægre ferre.
תְּלָאוּ fatigabitis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. לאה.
תְּלָאִים suspensi, Deut. 28. 66. pro תְּלוּיִם, Part. Pahul Kal, pl. Rad. תָּלָה.
וַתִּלְבַּב ut placentas paret, fut. Piel, 3. f. f. R. לבב.
תָּלַד paries, vel et, תְּלֵדִי paries, תִּלְדֵי parietis, תִּלְדֶּין parient, (pro נָה) fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. f. f. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. יָלַד.
תִּלְדֶּנָה pariant, Ezech. 23.4. pro תִּלְדֶּינָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. יָלַד.
וַתָּלֶה & furebat, Gen. 47.13. (pro וַתָּלֶה quod pro תִּלְהָה,) fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. Rad. לָהָה.
תְּלַהֵט incendes, vel det, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. לָהַט.
תָּלוּ suspenderunt, pret. Kal, 3. pl. R. תָּלָה.
תְּלָנָה mutuo acceperis, vel rit, fut. Kal, תִּלְוֶה mutuo dederis, vel rit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. לָוָה.
תָּלוּם suspenderunt eos, 2 Sam. 21. 12. (pro תָּקְאוּם,) quod juxta Consonantes pro תָּלוּם, pret. Kal, 3. pl. aff. Rad. תָּלָה, sed juxta Puncta, à Rad. inusit. תלא.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some consonants are small and faint; the vowel signs above are approximate. Doubtful: "לאב" (Rad. inusit., entry 3), "תְּלָנָה" and "תִּלְוֶה" (vowel points in entry 12), and "תָּלוּם" (entry 13). No marginal notes. The entry "תְּלָאָה" in the left column contains a Hebrew word marked "pro" and a Hebrew abbreviation which may be misread. The entry "וַתָּלֶה" has a Hebrew cross-reference that is hard to resolve.
